g.text: Gray CSA11x2->16 uses the current probe-selected crop/distance configuration; Gabor CSA24* uses HOSVD/context. Other ORL rows retain shared
references, so this is not one common input protocol. See REPORT for full settings; paper aggregation is unknown. Paper values: Xu et al., IEEE
